body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: up to 6 Cursor specialists in parallel (plan-fidelity when plan available) + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1: 6 Cursor specialists + Codex generic launched. Edge-cases specialist returned NOT_SUBSTANTIVE. 5 specialist + 1 Codex outputs collected.

**Accepted**: 1 finding (fetch failure gate — guard push/reset against stale origin/main ref)
**Rejected**: 6 findings (committed run log artifacts — by design; dirty tree reset — low-risk context; SKILL.md wording nit — minor; plan-pseudocode vs code divergence — code is correct; OOS .gitignore — out of scope; Codex reset-keep suggestion — overkill for context)
